interactions.purpose: Derive test cases for valid user registration (FR-01)
interactions.prompt: For the registration form at /register (fields: full name, email, password, confirm password, accept-terms checkbox), list the test cases for the VALID registration path only. Give each an ID and expected result.
interactions.ai_output:
TC-01 Register with all valid fields -> account created, redirected to /login with success banner.
TC-02 Register with the minimum valid password length (8 chars) -> account created.
TC-03 Register with a full name containing diacritics -> account created, name shown correctly on profile.
interactions.human_review: TC-01..TC-03 are reasonable and match the spec. AI did not ask whether email confirmation is required before login, which the spec does require - so TC-01's expected result is incomplete.
interactions.human_action: Kept all three cases, amended TC-01's expected result to 'account created in PENDING state, confirmation email sent, login blocked until confirmed'. Added TC-04 for the confirmation step myself.
interactions.reason_for_modification: AI assumed immediate activation; the SUT requires email confirmation.

issues.description: Incorrect assumption that registration activates the account immediately
issues.why: The prompt described the form fields but not the post-submit flow, so the AI filled the gap with the most common pattern instead of asking.
issues.human_correction: Expected results rewritten against the spec; a TC-04 for email confirmation was added by hand.
issues.resolution: Resolved before any automation was written.

interactions.purpose: Generate a Playwright test for TC-01 valid registration
interactions.prompt: Write a Playwright test in TypeScript for TC-01 (valid registration) on https://example-eshop.test/register. Test account: newuser+{ts}@example.test, password: [REDACTED] Assert the user lands on /login with a success message.
interactions.human_review: Three problems. (1) '.btn-primary' is fragile: the registration page has three buttons with that class (Submit, Cancel, and the newsletter button in the footer), so the test could click the wrong one and would break on any restyling. (2) waitForTimeout(3000) is an arbitrary sleep - flaky under load and slow. (3) The only assertion is the URL; the success banner and the PENDING account state required by TC-01 are never asserted, so the test would pass even if registration silently failed and redirected.
interactions.human_action: Replaced the click with getByRole('button', { name: 'Create account' }); removed waitForTimeout in favour of Playwright's auto-waiting web-first assertions; added assertions for the success banner text and for the confirmation-required message. Kept the AI's structure, env-var password handling and unique-email pattern.
interactions.reason_for_modification: Selector stability, flaky wait, and insufficient assertions - the test as generated could pass while the feature was broken.

issues.description: Fragile CSS selector '.btn-primary' - three buttons on the page share the class
issues.why: The AI had no access to the live DOM and inferred a selector from a common Bootstrap class name, assuming it was unique.
issues.human_correction: getByRole('button', { name: 'Create account' }) - semantic, unique, and resilient to restyling.
issues.resolution: Fixed. Test re-run green on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

issues.description: waitForTimeout(3000) hard-coded sleep instead of a web-first assertion
issues.why: A fixed sleep is a common pattern in older tutorials that dominate training data; the AI reached for it instead of Playwright auto-waiting.
issues.human_correction: Removed the sleep; relied on expect(page).toHaveURL() and expect(locator).toBeVisible() auto-retry.
issues.resolution: Fixed. Test runtime dropped from ~4.1s to ~1.3s.

issues.description: Missing assertions - only the URL was checked, not the success banner or the PENDING account state
issues.why: The prompt asked to 'assert the user lands on /login with a success message' but the AI implemented only the first half.
issues.human_correction: Added expect(page.getByText('Registration successful')).toBeVisible() and an assertion for the 'check your email to confirm' notice from TC-01.
issues.resolution: Fixed. Verified the test now fails when the banner is suppressed.
